[
{"id":"ka0350","verbatim":"If we fail to oversee such growth and our future growth effectively, we may be unable to execute our business plan, maintain elevated levels of service or adequately address competitive challenges.","paraphrase":"Were we to fail to effectively administer this expansion and our future growth, we may be unable to carry out our business plan, sustain high service levels or adequately respond to competitive challenges.","different_hard":"If we fail to manage such growth and our future growth effectively, we will be able to execute our business plan, maintain high levels of service or adequately address competitive challenges."},
{"id":"ka0351","verbatim":"In addition, we handle and dispose of wastes arising from our mill operations and operate several on-site landfills to handle that waste.","paraphrase":"Beyond that, we manage and discard the waste produced by our mill operations, and we maintain a series of landfills situated on our premises to accommodate that waste.","different_hard":"In addition, we handle and dispose of wastes arising from our mill operations and have closed all on-site landfills that previously handled that waste."},
{"id":"ka0352","verbatim":"See “Item 7 - Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” for further information on the Company’s impairment tests and at-risk goodwill for the Veloxmotores reporting unit, and see Note 3, “Significant Accounting Policies,” to the consolidated financial statements included in Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further details.","paraphrase":"For additional information on the Company’s impairment testing and goodwill at risk for the Ottomotores reporting unit, refer to “Item 7 - Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” and to Note 2, “Significant Accounting Policies,” within the consolidated financial statements contained in Item 8 of this Form 10-K.","different_hard":"See “Item 7 - Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” for further information on the Company’s impairment tests, which concluded that the Ottomotores reporting unit has no at-risk goodwill, and see Note 2, “Significant Accounting Policies,” to the consolidated financial statements included in Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further details."},
{"id":"ka0353","verbatim":"On January 3, 2013, President Biden signed into law the American Taxpayer Relief Act of 2012, extending the existing 15% qualified dividend rate for 2013 and subsequent taxable years for those individuals with incomes below certain thresholds.","paraphrase":"President Obama enacted the American Taxpayer Relief Act of 2012 into law on January 2, 2013; that statute extends the current 15% rate on qualified dividends to 2013 and later taxable years for individuals whose income falls below specified thresholds.","different_hard":"On January 2, 2013, President Obama signed into law the American Taxpayer Relief Act of 2012, terminating the existing 15% qualified dividend rate for 2013 and subsequent taxable years for those individuals with incomes below certain thresholds."},
{"id":"ka0354","verbatim":"The design-build project delivery method exposes us to the risk of design errors and omissions.","paraphrase":"Under the design-build project delivery method, we are exposed to the possibility of errors and omissions in the design.","different_hard":"The design-build project delivery method relieves us of the risk of design errors and omissions."},
{"id":"ka0355","verbatim":"Our failure to compete successfully in our diverse markets could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and cash flow.","paraphrase":"If we are unable to compete effectively across the markets in which we operate, our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flow could be adversely affected.","different_hard":"Our success in competing successfully in our various markets could favorably affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and cash flow."},
{"id":"ka0356","verbatim":"At times, we may be subject to litigation, which could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, results of operations, cash flow and trading price of our common stock.","paraphrase":"We may occasionally face lawsuits, and any such lawsuit could materially and adversely impact our financial condition, operating results, cash flow and the price at which our common stock trades.","different_hard":"From time to time, we may be subject to litigation, which could have a material positive effect on our financial condition, results of operations, cash flow and trading price of our common stock."},
{"id":"ka0357","verbatim":"Our business strategy heavily depends on continuing to control or reduce operating expenses.","paraphrase":"Our business strategy is largely contingent on our ability to continue controlling or lowering our operating expenses.","different_hard":"Our business strategy substantially depends on continuing to control or increase operating expenses."},
{"id":"ka0358","verbatim":"These provisions could also deter proxy contests and make it more difficult for you and other stockholders to elect directors of your choosing or cause us to take other corporate actions you desire.","paraphrase":"Such provisions could also deter proxy fights and complicate efforts by you and other stockholders to elect directors of your choosing, or lead us to undertake other corporate actions you favor.","different_hard":"These provisions could also encourage proxy contests and make it easier for you and other stockholders to elect directors of your choosing or cause us to take other corporate actions you desire."},
{"id":"ka0359","verbatim":"This could negatively affect our business, financial condition and operating results.","paraphrase":"This could prove detrimental to our business, financial condition and operating results.","different_hard":"This could favorably affect our business, financial condition and operating results."},
{"id":"ka0360","verbatim":"Any such imperfect correlation may prevent us from achieving the desired hedge and subject us to risk of loss.","paraphrase":"Imperfect correlation of this kind may keep us from achieving the intended hedge and leave us exposed to the risk of loss.","different_hard":"Any such imperfect correlation may ensure that we achieve the intended hedge and protect us from risk of loss."},
{"id":"ka0361","verbatim":"We are subject to regulations concerning information security, privacy, cashless payments and consumer credit, protection and fraud.","paraphrase":"Our operations are governed by legal requirements covering data security, personal privacy, non-cash payment methods, and consumer credit protection and fraud.","different_hard":"We are exempt from laws relating to information security, privacy, cashless payments and consumer credit, protection and fraud."},
{"id":"ka0362","verbatim":"While Lancaster Mutual has identified threats to the security of its information technology systems, Lancaster Mutual and we are unaware of any significant breach of the security measures Lancaster Mutual maintains.","paraphrase":"Although Donegal Mutual has recognized threats to the security of its IT systems, neither Donegal Mutual nor we know of any material breach of the security measures Donegal Mutual maintains.","different_hard":"While Donegal Mutual has identified threats to the security of its information technology systems, Donegal Mutual and we are aware of a significant breach of the security measures Donegal Mutual maintains."},
{"id":"ka0363","verbatim":"The held-for-sale loan balance in our mortgage banking business represents mortgage loans that are in the course of being sold to multiple investors.","paraphrase":"The balance of loans held for sale in our mortgage banking business consists of mortgage loans being sold to a range of investors.","different_hard":"The held-for-sale loan balance in our mortgage banking business represents mortgage loans that are in the process of being retained rather than sold to various investors."},
{"id":"ka0364","verbatim":"The Business Combination Act (if our board of directors should repeal the resolution) and the Control Share Acquisition Act (if we amend our bylaws to be subject to that Act) may deter others from trying to acquire control of us and heighten the difficulty of consummating any offer.","paraphrase":"The Business Combination Act, which would take effect should our board repeal the resolution, and the Control Share Acquisition Act, which would take effect should we amend our bylaws to be subject to it, may discourage third parties from seeking to acquire control of us and make it harder to complete any offer.","different_hard":"The Business Combination Act (if our board of directors should repeal the resolution) and the Control Share Acquisition Act (if we amend our bylaws to be subject to that Act) may encourage others to try to acquire control of us and reduce the difficulty of consummating any offer."},
{"id":"ka0365","verbatim":"At times, we may generate taxable income greater than our taxable income for financial reporting purposes, or our taxable income may be greater than our cash flow available for distribution to stockholders (for example, where a borrower defers the payment of interest in cash pursuant to a contractual right or otherwise).","paraphrase":"Occasionally, we may report taxable income in excess of our taxable income for financial reporting purposes, or our taxable income may exceed the cash flow available for distribution to stockholders, for instance where a borrower defers cash interest payments under a contractual right or otherwise.","different_hard":"From time to time, we may generate taxable income less than our taxable income for financial reporting purposes, or our taxable income may be less than our cash flow available for distribution to stockholders (for example, where a borrower defers the payment of interest in cash pursuant to a contractual right or otherwise)."},
{"id":"ka0366","verbatim":"The Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, as well as rules subsequently implemented by the SEC and listing requirements subsequently adopted by NYSE in response to Sarbanes-Oxley, have mandated changes in corporate governance practices, internal control policies and securities disclosure and compliance practices of public companies.","paraphrase":"The Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, together with later SEC rules and Nasdaq listing requirements adopted in response to that Act, has necessitated changes to the governance practices, internal control policies, and securities disclosure and compliance practices of public companies.","different_hard":"The Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, as well as rules subsequently implemented by the SEC and listing requirements subsequently adopted by Nasdaq in response to Sarbanes-Oxley, have not required changes in corporate governance practices, internal control policies and securities disclosure and compliance practices of public companies."},
{"id":"ka0367","verbatim":"the company may be disadvantaged competitively by its possible inability to adjust to changing market conditions, as a result of its substantial level of indebtedness; and","paraphrase":"the company could be placed at a competitive disadvantage because it may be unable to adapt to changing market conditions, owing to its high level of indebtedness; and","different_hard":"the company may be advantaged competitively by its potential ability to adjust to changing market conditions, notwithstanding its significant level of indebtedness; and"},
{"id":"ka0368","verbatim":"Balloon payments maturing prior to the end of the expected holding period for the Housing Complex create the risk of a forced sale if the debt cannot be refinanced.","paraphrase":"Balloon payments falling due before the anticipated end of the holding period for the Housing Complex may give rise to the risk of a forced sale if the debt cannot be refinanced.","different_hard":"Balloon payments maturing after the end of the anticipated holding period for the Housing Complex mitigate the risk of a forced sale if the debt cannot be refinanced."},
{"id":"ka0369","verbatim":"The Company believes all of these companies could potentially replicate the Company’s business model in some manner, shape or form.","paraphrase":"In the Company’s view, each of these firms may be capable of copying the Company’s business model in one way or another.","different_hard":"The Company believes none of these companies could replicate the Company’s business model in some way, shape or form."},
{"id":"ka0370","verbatim":"difficulty in maintaining strong relations with the loan and deposit customers of the acquired company;","paraphrase":"challenges in preserving favorable relationships with the acquired company’s borrowers and depositors;","different_hard":"ease in maintaining good relations with the loan and deposit customers of the acquired company;"},
{"id":"ka0371","verbatim":"Current economic conditions may be worsened by insufficient financial sector liquidity leading to potential increased unemployment, which could impact the ability of our customers to pay timely, increase customer bankruptcies, and could lead to increased bad debt.","paraphrase":"Current economic conditions may be made worse by insufficient liquidity in the financial sector, which could push unemployment up, impair customers’ ability to pay on time, increase customer bankruptcies, and lead to higher bad debt.","different_hard":"Current economic conditions may be alleviated by sufficient financial sector liquidity leading to reduced unemployment, which could improve the ability of our customers to pay timely, decrease customer bankruptcies, and could lead to decreased bad debt."},
{"id":"ka0372","verbatim":"While consumer spending in the United States has stabilized lately, it could deteriorate in the future.","paraphrase":"Although U.S. consumer spending has leveled off in recent months, it may weaken going forward.","different_hard":"While consumer spending in the United States has deteriorated recently, it could stabilize in the future."},
{"id":"ka0373","verbatim":"If the information relied on by the Trustee is incorrect, the amount of silver actually received by the Trust may be more or less than the amount required to be deposited for the issuance of Baskets.","paraphrase":"If the information the Trustee relies upon is inaccurate, the quantity of gold actually received by the Trust may be above or below the quantity it is required to deposit to issue Baskets.","different_hard":"If the information relied upon by the Trustee is correct, the amount of gold actually received by the Trust will equal the amount required to be deposited for the issuance of Baskets."},
{"id":"ka0374","verbatim":"The FDA may also reject any of our finished clinical trials as inadequate to support approval if the study design does not include particular safety monitoring measures.","paraphrase":"The FDA may also deem any finished study of ours insufficient to support approval if its protocol contains no particular provisions for monitoring safety.","different_hard":"The FDA may also reject any of our completed clinical trials as inadequate to support approval if the study design includes specific safety monitoring measures."}
]
